request.style: English, small-combo swing jazz, playful bright female vocal, clarinet, muted trumpet, piano, upright bass, brushed drums, festive and warm, 122 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
There's a wedding up in Cana on the third day of the week
The tables full of family and the music's at its peak
But the servants start to whisper and the steward starts to frown
The wine is running out before the sun is going down

[Verse]
His mother leans toward him, says they have no more wine
He tells her that his hour has not yet come, not yet the time
But she turns to the servants with a quiet knowing nod
Do whatever he tells you, and she leaves the rest to God

[Chorus]
You have kept the good wine until now
Six stone jars filled to the brim somehow
Water poured and wine came out
You have kept the good wine until now

[Verse]
Fill the jars with water, so they fill them to the top
Now draw some out and take it, and they don't spill a drop
The steward takes a sip of it and calls the bridegroom near
Everyone serves the good wine first, but the best is only here

[Chorus]
You have kept the good wine until now
Six stone jars filled to the brim somehow
Water poured and wine came out
You have kept the good wine until now

[Bridge]
The first of his signs at Cana in Galilee
He revealed his glory for his friends to see
And his disciples believed in him

[Outro]
You have kept the good wine
The good wine until now
